+	if proxySettings.Kube.Enabled {
+		kubeAddr := proxySettings.Kube.PublicAddr
+		if kubeAddr == "" {
+			kubeAddr = proxySettings.Kube.ListenAddr
+		}
+		if kubeAddr == "" {
+			webProxyHost, _ := tc.WebProxyHostPort()
+			tc.KubeProxyAddr = net.JoinHostPort(webProxyHost, strconv.Itoa(defaults.KubeListenPort))
+		} else {
+			addr, err := utils.ParseHostPortAddr(kubeAddr, defaults.KubeListenPort)
+			if err != nil {
+				return trace.BadParameter(
+					"failed to parse value received from the server: %q, contact your administrator for help", kubeAddr)
+			}
+			host := addr.Host()
+			if ip := net.ParseIP(host); ip != nil && ip.IsUnspecified() {
+				host, _ = tc.WebProxyHostPort()
+			}
+			tc.KubeProxyAddr = net.JoinHostPort(host, strconv.Itoa(addr.Port(defaults.KubeListenPort)))
+		}
+	}

 }
